title: Authority Bias
coreMove: Detect when the authority bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Authority Bias as a specific decision error around authority bias, Milgram, credentials. Traceable support includes Iatrogenic.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Authority Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the authority bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
